evt_after.desc: queue a call to a root-scope def; it runs at the script's next yield() point

param.desc: delay in milliseconds; 0 = eligible at once (the heartbeat grants it, ~50ms quantum)
root-scope def name, resolved when the delivery is serviced
values passed to the def; the delivery holds them until serviced

ret.desc: true = queued, false = the yield queue is full (delivery refused)
